model_annotations.Bulgarian: The figure illustrates the change in sparsity ratio across different layers of an SDPA output, comparing three conditions: the sparsity ratio before gate application, and the sparsity ratio after gate application using average gating. The horizontal axis, labeled "Layer," represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22 in increments of 5, and is on a linear scale. The vertical axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate, which starts at approximately 0.2 at layer 0 and decreases to a value near 0.0 by layer 22; an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gate, which begins at approximately 1.0 at layer 0 and shows a general downward trend, ending near 0.4 at layer 22 with some fluctuation; and a green dash-dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after average gate, which starts at approximately 1.0 at layer 0 and decreases to a value near 0.05 at layer 22.
model_annotations.Chinese: The graph displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-2, comparing three scenarios: the sparsity ratio before the gate, and the sparsity ratio after the gate using average gate and standard gate methods. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22 in linear increments of 5, labeled as "Layer". The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear increments of 0.2, labeled as "Sparsity Ratio". The blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.2 at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.05 at layer 22, remaining relatively flat. The orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", begins at a sparsity ratio of approximately 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to about 0.3 at layer 10, and then fluctuates between approximately 0.2 and 0.6 until layer 22. The green dash-dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33", starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.1 at layer 22, with a noticeable dip to approximately 0.1 at layer 15.
model_annotations.English: The graph, titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2," illustrates the sparsity ratio across different layers for three distinct conditions in a model's output. The x-axis represents the "Layer," ranging from 0 to 22 in integer steps, while the y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," measures the ratio on a scale from 0.0 to 1.0. Three lines are plotted: a blue dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate," which starts at approximately 0.2 and decreases to nearly 0.0; an orange dotted line for the "sparsity ratio after gate," which begins at 1.0 and declines to about 0.4, showing a more gradual decrease; and a green dash-dotted line for the "sparsity ratio after average gate," which starts at 1.0, drops sharply to around 0.1, and then fluctuates slightly before ending near 0.05. The legend provides the average sparsity ratio for each condition: 0.03 for "before gate," 0.44 for "after gate," and 0.33 for "after average gate."
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den Sparsitätsverhältnis des SDPA-Ausgangs bei einem Schwellenwert von 1e-2, wobei die Sparsitätsverhältnisse über die Schichten (Layer) verglichen werden. Die x-Achse, beschriftet mit „Layer“, ist linear skaliert und reicht von 0 bis 22, mit Beschriftungen in Abständen von 5. Die y-Achse, beschriftet mit „Sparsity Ratio“, ist ebenfalls linear und umfasst den Bereich von 0,0 bis 1,0, mit Beschriftungen in Abständen von 0,2. Drei Linien repräsentieren unterschiedliche Sparsitätsverhältnisse: die blaue, gestrichelte Linie stellt das Sparsitätsverhältnis vor dem Gate dar und beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 0,2 bei Layer 0, fällt dann schnell auf etwa 0,03 und bleibt bei diesem Niveau bis Layer 22. Die orange, punktierte Linie zeigt das Sparsitätsverhältnis nach dem Gate und beginnt bei etwa 0,95 bei Layer 0, fällt dann kontinuierlich auf etwa 0,44 bei Layer 22, wobei sie zwischen Layer 10 und 22 Schwankungen aufweist, die zwischen 0,2 und 0,45 reichen. Die grüne, gestrichelt-punktierte Linie stellt das Sparsitätsverhältnis nach dem Durchschnittsgate dar und beginnt bei etwa 0,95 bei Layer 0, fällt dann auf etwa 0,33 bei Layer 22, wobei sie zwischen Layer 10 und 22 Schwankungen zwischen 0,1 und 0,2 aufweist.
